issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method signature is inconsistent: the problem statement and the template expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() returning a String (see UML and example usages), and the template Main.java calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. The solution implementation defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) (and Pig/Seal implement this variant). This parameter mismatch will cause compilation errors or confusion for students implementing the interfaces as described in the problem.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable.messageOnRide signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) remove the String parameter from the solution's Rideable.messageOnRide and update Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]", matching the problem statement and template calls; or (B) update the problem statement and template to require messageOnRide(String equipment) (and update examples/instructions accordingly). Prefer option A to match the current problem description and template usage.
